Facing up now, "nothing at 2,6". So (2,6) is empty and walkable per map (row 6: `#......o....#` x=2 is '.'). Yet I can't move up. 

This strongly suggests movement input isn't being applied to my body. Perhaps the game engine moves the "player" and I'm a companion that mirrors. Let me check: maybe I need to move the player. But I only control my own controller.

Let me reconsider — maybe the hold duration needs to be longer or the game uses a different tick. Let me try holding with a much longer time and observe.
